headword: {購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}

definitions.explanation: An advance commitment to buy a product before it is released or becomes available. Common for books, games, electronics, and limited-edition items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けています→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Pre-orders are accepted through the official website.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定版|げんていばん}→限定版：17391_genteiban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: You might not be able to get the limited edition unless you pre-order it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧ (purchase) + ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation). Used in both online and physical retail contexts. In Japan, pre-ordering is common for manga, video games, concert merchandise, and seasonal items like ⟦{福袋|ふくぶくろ}→福袋：08159_fukubukuro⟧ (lucky bags).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: pre-order
- {購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧: accept pre-orders
- {購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧: pre-order bonus
- {購入予約|こうにゅうよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}す→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧: cancel a pre-order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: reservation; booking — broader term that includes restaurant and hotel reservations
- ⟦{先行予約|せんこうよやく}→先行予約：17983_senkouyoyaku⟧: advance reservation — priority pre-ordering, often for fans or members
- {取|と}り{置|お}き: holding; setting aside — reserving an existing item at a store
